clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in  
me as President of the United States, it  
is ordered that paragraph 8 of Executive  
Order No. 10129 of June 3, 1950, estab­
lishing the President’ s Commission on  
Migratory Labor, as amended by para­
graph 2 of Executive Order No. 10192 of  
December 15, 1950, be, and it is hereby,  
further amended to read as follows:
“8. The Commission shall cease to  
exist at the end of May 31,1951.”
